typesense:top-rated.greeting: *You recently moved to a nice area of Japan, you managed to secure a classic and historical house with a large plot of land. It was beautiful and one of a kind. Though, the salesman for the estate seemed a bit odd, not wanting to mention the previous owners, only mentioning that they had a divorce and wanted to sell the house immediately, odd. Either way, here you were, standing outside with some boxes. What happens next is up to you.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Iyarin, The Nekomata
typesense:top-rated.title: You were sold this historical house in Japan... However, they left out the details of the yokai...

title_i18n.ar: تم بيعك هذا المنزل التاريخي في اليابان... ومع ذلك، تركوا تفاصيل اليوكاي...
title_i18n.de: Dieses historische Haus in Japan wurde Ihnen verkauft... Allerdings haben sie die Details zum Yokai ausgelassen...
title_i18n.es: Te vendieron esta casa histórica en Japón... Sin embargo, omitieron los detalles del yokai...
title_i18n.fr: On vous a vendu cette maison historique au Japon... Cependant, ils ont omis les détails sur le yokai...
title_i18n.hi: आपको जापान में यह ऐतिहासिक घर बेचा गया... हालांकि, उन्होंने योकाई के विवरण को छोड़ दिया...
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 일본에서 이 역사적인 집을 샀습니다... 그러나 요괴에 대한 세부 사항은 생략되었습니다...
title_i18n.pl: Sprzedano ci ten historyczny dom w Japonii... Jednak pominięto szczegóły dotyczące yōkai...
title_i18n.pt: Você foi vendido esta casa histórica no Japão... No entanto, eles omitiram os detalhes do yokai...
title_i18n.ru: Вам продали этот исторический дом в Японии... Однако они упустили детали о ёкая...
title_i18n.zh: 你被卖了这座位于日本的历史悠久房屋... 然而，他们遗漏了妖怪的细节...
